_comment: 3D props generated with the local ComfyUI toolkit (Z-Image Turbo → BiRefNet → TRELLIS.2). size = real width x depth x height in metres (from research/00-consolidated.md section 10); faces = target triangle count. Run: node tools/gen/run-props.mjs [name ...] Trees are modelled procedurally (generated tree meshes were too blobby at an instancing-friendly triangle count).
style: single object, isolated and centered, whole object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain pure white background, soft even diffuse studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no people, photorealistic product photo
